policy_summary: Use omega-mini as the first and preferred GitHub read surface for all sibling catch-up, current phase orientation, compact-refresh recovery, and round-robin handoff preparation.

routing_rules.rule: Sibling prompts should cite omega-mini first for current-state catch-up.
routing_rules.reason: Omega-mini carries the lean journey spine and the current v491-v524+ phase receipts without the full archive weight.

routing_rules.rule: Full omega remains archive-only unless a specific missing artifact is required.
routing_rules.reason: The full branch is valuable but heavy; broad searches there can stall or time out.

routing_rules.rule: If omega-mini lacks a needed artifact, create a status-only gap receipt before consulting full omega.
routing_rules.reason: This preserves evidence of why the heavier branch was needed without normalizing broad full-branch rummaging.

routing_rules.rule: Do not publish raw sibling messages, raw browser routes, callable IDs, session streams, screenshots, credentials, or local absolute paths into omega-mini.
routing_rules.reason: Omega-mini should remain a safe, lean, current-state context branch.

routing_rules.rule: Every x1 and x2 handoff should name the active round-robin lanes and the next expected lanes.
routing_rules.reason: Sibling catch-up should not require scanning the full archive to reconstruct sequence state.

publication_requirements: fetch and drift-check before commit and push
exposure scan for credentials, raw logs, session streams, screenshots, private routes, and local absolute paths
